snippet.title: Project Motor Racing | Update 2.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Project Motor Racing Update 2.0 represents the most comprehensive overhaul of the simulation since launch.

Built alongside community feedback and sim racing pros and developers, this update touches every core system in the sim. From how the sim looks and navigates to how it feels to drive and how you compete online.

Key improvements include:
► Fully redesigned UI for faster, clearer navigation
► A new tyre model with more progressive grip and slip behaviour
► Improved force feedback and handling across multiple classes
► Enhanced online systems, including anti-cheat and License Points
► Career Mode improvements with clearer structure and engagement

Update 2.0 establishes a new baseline for Project Motor Racing moving forward.

Available now on all platforms.
